currency.basis: Observed live on monzo.com (fetched 2026-10-04); the site serves this SVG as its current icon.

identity.basis: The M mark is Monzo's brand symbol; the asset is served from the official monzo.com domain as its favicon.

assessment.independenceRationale: Single official source; currency confirmed from the bank's own live site, sufficient for an operating brand.

variant.basis: Standalone M mark without wordmark or background, gradient leg variant, transparent background — directly suitable for a square catalog cell.

candidate.detailsJudgement: All four filled shapes and both linear gradients are preserved from the official asset; librsvg source vs final comparison is pixel-identical (difference bbox empty); no detail loss from the switch unwrap.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: Native viewBox 0 0 1024 926 kept; the catalog ContentScale.Fit places the mark centered in the square cell without stretching; final 240x240 frames show full emblem with clear margins on both themes.
candidate.rationale: Replace the flat-fill M on a dark circle with the current official standalone M mark as served by monzo.com itself: gradient teal/coral legs and current chevron colors on a transparent background. Supported currency update for the operating brand; the dark circular backing is a catalog adaptation of an earlier presentation, not an observed current official presentation.
candidate.role: Standalone bank brand mark (the Monzo M), used by the bank as its own favicon/app icon.
transforms: No geometry transformation: the official emblem is used at its native proportions; only the incidental <switch> wrapper around the single content group was removed because the catalog SVG converter rejects <switch> (rendered output verified pixel-identical under librsvg).
SVGO 4.1.0 trial with repository svgo.config.mjs (config sha256 f2a406e0...) produced 1738 bytes from 1640 bytes; the larger optimized output was NOT selected and the working bytes were kept.
candidate.variant: Current gradient-fill M mark without wordmark or background circle, transparent background.
candidate.visibleDiffExplanation: The update replaces the catalog's dark-circle flat-color M with the current official gradient M on transparent background: visibly different fills (gradient teal/coral legs, current chevron colors) and removal of the non-official dark backing circle.

proposals.reason: Official current Monzo "M" mark SVG served as the live monzo.com favicon; same M silhouette as the baseline but with the current gradient leg fills and without the baseline dark background circle. Supported replacement for the operating brand.

sourceCandidate.rationale: Official current favicon SVG as fetched; original vector, self-contained, no raster. Baseline shows the same silhouette in flat fills on a dark circle; candidate is the current official rendering.

sources.observation: Live monzo.com press page links rel=icon type=image/svg+xml to this asset; fetched 1640-byte self-contained SVG, viewBox 0 0 1024 926, gradient teal/coral legs, #bbf42e/#48d3b2 chevrons, transparent background.
Official 2026 press kit exists; fetch exceeded the 16 MiB workflow cap (curl exit 63) — access fact, not blocking.
